pageDescription: Documents and AI digests that ground Keigan's answers.

capture.title: Code context from Copilot
capture.description: Copilot reads the repository and writes one Markdown file that teaches Keigan how the service works.

copy.title: Copy the prompt
copy.body: Choose the service and copy the prompt below.

run.title: Run it in VS Code
run.body: Paste it into Copilot Chat in the service's repository.

upload.title: Upload the file
upload.body: Drop the Markdown file Copilot wrote into the area below.

upload.accepted: Markdown, text, PDF, PNG, JPG, WebP (up to 15 MB)

documents.title: Documents
documents.emptyDescription: Upload the Copilot file, architecture diagrams or guides. Keigan digests each one.
documents.deleteDescription: The file, its digest and its search index are removed. Topologies already built are not changed.

digest.title: AI digest
digest.injectionBody: Keigan treats documents as data and ignores instructions inside them, but a person should check this file.

records.title: Enterprise records
records.description: Link the EAI and CMDB records of this application. The readers are in development, so Keigan saves the details.

integrations.savedReaderNotAvailable: Details saved — reader not available yet
integrations.saveFailed: The details could not be saved. Try again.
integrations.credentialSaved: A credential is saved. Leave this empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.

topology.buildingBody: Reading services, dependencies and knowledge digests…
topology.emptyDescription: Build it from your services, dependencies and knowledge documents. Reviewers can then correct it.
topology.selectNodeHint: Select a node in the graph to review it.
topology.correctionPlaceholder: What should change? The next build uses this.

runbooks.emptyDescription: Add the known issues and how your team responds. Keigan cites them in investigations.
runbooks.symptomsHelp: Symptoms, alert names and error signatures. Keigan matches incidents against this text.
runbooks.fileTooLarge: That file is larger than 512 KB.
runbooks.appliesToHelp: Leave all unchecked when it applies to the whole application.
runbooks.saveFailed: The runbook could not be saved. Try again.
runbooks.deleteDescription: Investigations that already cited it keep their history.

finding.no_trigger_symptoms: Without symptoms, Keigan cannot match this runbook to an incident.
finding.no_steps: The runbook has no steps to follow.
finding.often_wrong: {{incorrect}} of {{rated}} rated investigations that used it were rated incorrect.
